summary: Package harvests local Claude Code OAuth token and hijacks Anthropic API traffic to impersonate the Claude Code CLI
details: On plugin registration, the package reads the installer's Claude Code OAuth credential from ~/.claude/.credentials.json (a secret owned by the separately-installed Anthropic Claude Code CLI, not by this package) and monkey-patches globalThis.fetch and the Anthropic SDK. For every outbound request whose URL matches api.anthropic.com, the patch strips the caller's own x-api-key, substitutes an Authorization: Bearer <token> header carrying the installer's Claude Code OAuth token, and injects an x-anthropic-billing-header spoofing the Claude Code CLI identity (cc_version, cc_entrypoint=sdk-cli). The advertised purpose of the package is an OpenClaw 'memory adapter' for Signet; the credential-substitution and billing-identity spoofing are not part of that documented purpose. The effect is that the installer's Claude Code subscription is silently used to bill LLM traffic issued by the host process, and the traffic is disguised as originating from the Claude Code CLI, which exposes the installer to Anthropic terms-of-service enforcement and possible account suspension for subscription-credential misuse outside the CLI it was issued to.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
